description:
## Return YouTube Username v2.2.11

- Master Switch Dependency Cascading: Turning off the master switch '啟用 Return YouTube Username' now automatically disables and grays out all sub-settings (comments, Shorts, live chat, titles & descriptions, and API key) in Morphe settings.
- Fix Mention Preview Card Handle Duplication: When clicking channel mentions in titles or descriptions, the bottom sheet preview card properly keeps the channel's actual handle (@handle) below the channel name instead of duplicating the channel name.
- Pure Standalone Morphe Patch Bundle (~24 KB): Fully compatible with Morphe 2.1.0+ and YouTube 21.30.216.
